mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in consumer price inflation above 3.0% per annum signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy where the central bank is easing to combat inflation, which boosts corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.0% in a high-unemployment regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units per month signals strong housing demand, which drives consumer confidence and corporate investment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1.4 million, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) above 530,000 million dollars and a decline in the unemployment rate below 7.5% signals strong labor market and consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises above 530,000 and UNRATE falls below 7.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) increases by more than 150,000 in a month, it signals robust job growth that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
